title: A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training
abstract: arXiv:2609.13171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

translated_title: 物理信息神经网络中的导数保真度失效模式：来自函数值训练的强化基准证据
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）使用自动微分来施加微分方程残差，但函数值上的良好拟合并不一定意味着导数也是准确的。本文将导数保真度表述为PINNs的一种失效模式，并通过一维基准测试加以验证。多层感知机仅在 sin(x) 和 exp(x) 的函数值上进行训练，而通过自动微分获得的二阶导数则被单独评估。通过对训练点密度、激活函数、端点密集评估以及L2误差和最大误差等多种诊断手段的补充测试，该假设得到了进一步强化。结果表明，视觉上准确的函数逼近可能与显著更大的二阶导数误差并存，尤其是在高曲率边界区域附近。该实验提供了一种诊断协议，用于区分函数值精度与物理残差的可靠性。
tldr: 该论文揭示了物理信息神经网络的一种失效模式：即使函数值逼近在视觉上高度准确，其通过自动微分得到的二阶导数仍可能存在显著误差，尤其是在靠近边界的高曲率区域，并提出了一种区分函数值精度与物理残差可靠性的诊断协议。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks, demonstrating that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors—especially near high-curvature boundary regions—and provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.
